summary.short: Specifies sector-based descriptions of qualifying entities and activities in the United Kingdom that make a change of control a notifiable acquisition under the National Security and Investment Act 2021, from 4 January 2022. Schedules cover 17 sectors, including artificial intelligence, computing hardware, data infrastructure and energy.
summary.long: Made under section 6 of the National Security and Investment Act 2021 and in force from 4 January 2022, these Regulations specify descriptions of qualifying entity for notifiable acquisitions. Regulation 2 links the descriptions to Schedules 1 to 17; a qualifying entity falls within one only if it carries on the activity in the United Kingdom. The Schedules cover sectors including advanced materials, advanced robotics, artificial intelligence, computing hardware, cryptographic authentication, data infrastructure, energy, quantum technologies and satellite and space technology. Schedule 3 covers research into artificial intelligence and the development or production of AI goods, software or technology used for identification or tracking, advanced robotics or cyber security. Schedule 11 applies to entities owning or operating a generating asset of at least 100 megawatts, or with relevant capacity of at least one gigawatt. Regulation 4 requires periodic reviews, the first within three years of commencement. They extend to England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland.

notes: Only relations, entities and notes are filled in this pass. The regulations specify sector descriptions of qualifying entities in Schedules 1 to 17; under regulation 2(2) an activity counts only if carried on in the United Kingdom. The AI-specific description is Schedule 3 (research into AI, or developing or producing AI-using goods, software or technology for identification or tracking, advanced robotics or cyber security). Schedule 2 also uses AI in its core-component definition. Entities list selected public bodies only; the Schedule 9 and Schedule 15 lists are longer. Schema-required fields without a value are empty strings: target_instrument_id (no registry match) and lei/ticker. Internal points: the Explanatory Note says 'National Security and Investments Act 2021', while the title and regulation 2 use 'Investment'; Schedule 9 contains amendment markers F1 to F5 and two blank 'F4. . .' lines; Schedule 3, paragraph 2(1) refers to purposes in 'sub-paragraph 2', meaning paragraph 2(2). The section_status for relations and entities is recorded as not_applicable only because the schema permits no other value for sections that are not empty; both sections contain entries.

obligations.summary: The Secretary of State must from time to time review the regulatory provisions of these Regulations and publish a report on the conclusions. The first report is due within three years of commencement and later reports at intervals not exceeding three years. The report must set out the objectives, assess whether they are achieved and remain appropriate, and assess whether they could be achieved in a less onerous way.

obligations.summary: Sch. 9 (data infrastructure): a qualifying entity owning, operating, managing or providing listed services for relevant data infrastructure used for administration of the public sector authorities in para. 2 falls within the description.

evidence.quote: A qualifying entity carrying on any of the activities set out in paragraph 4

obligations.summary: Sch. 10 (defence): a qualifying entity carrying on research, development, production, creation or application of defence or national security goods or services falls within the description if it is a government contractor or sub-contractor, or has been notified of classified information.

evidence.quote: A qualifying entity carrying on activities that comprise or include the research, development, production, creation or application of goods or services

obligations.summary: Sch. 11 (energy): a qualifying entity carrying on listed activities in relation to existing or new upstream petroleum facilities, electricity licences or generating assets, gas facilities, or fuel supply falls within the description, subject to the throughput, capacity and tonnage conditions in para. 4.

evidence.quote: A qualifying entity carrying on any of the activities set out in paragraph 3

obligations.summary: Sch. 12 (military and dual-use): a qualifying entity carrying on research, development or production of restricted goods or restricted technology under listed export control legislation falls within the description.

evidence.quote: A qualifying entity carrying on activities that consist of or include researching, developing or producing restricted goods or restricted technology

obligations.summary: Sch. 13 (quantum technologies): a qualifying entity carrying on activities that consist of developing or producing quantum technology, as defined in para. 1, falls within the description.

evidence.quote: A qualifying entity carrying on activities that consist of developing or producing quantum technology

obligations.summary: Sch. 14 (satellite and space technology): a qualifying entity operating, developing, producing or using listed space facilities or carrying on listed space activities (debris management, in-orbit servicing, satellite links, defence use of space-derived data and similar) falls within the description.

evidence.quote: A qualifying entity carrying on activities that consist of or include operating, developing, producing, creating or using facilities for any of the activities set out in paragraph 3

obligations.summary: Sch. 15 (suppliers to emergency services): a qualifying entity supplying listed goods and services directly to an emergency service (para. 3) or to an ambulance services provider (para. 4) falls within the description.

evidence.quote: A qualifying entity which supplies directly to

obligations.summary: Sch. 16 (synthetic biology): subject to the exceptions in paras. 5 and 6, a qualifying entity carrying on basic research into synthetic biology, or its development, production, degradation formulation or provision of enabling services, falls within the description.

evidence.quote: Subject to the exceptions referred to in paragraphs 5 and 6, a qualifying entity carrying on activities that consist of or include any of the following

obligations.summary: Sch. 17 para. 2 (ports and harbours): a qualifying entity owning or operating a UK port or harbour that handled 1 million tonnes or more of cargo in the preceding year, or owning and operating terminals or infrastructure in such a port, falls within the description.

evidence.quote: owning or operating a port or harbour in the United Kingdom that handled 1 million tonnes or more of cargo

obligations.summary: Sch. 17 para. 4 (airports and air traffic control): a qualifying entity owning or operating a UK airport that handled at least six million passenger movements or 100,000 tonnes of freight in 2018, providing en route air traffic control services in the UK, or owning such a provider falls within the description.

evidence.quote: owning or operating an airport in the United Kingdom that handled at least six million passenger movements or 100,000 tonnes of freight in 2018

enforcement.note: The Regulations only specify descriptions of qualifying entities and activities (regs 2-4, Schedules 1-17) under powers in sections 6 and 8 of the Act. They contain no fines, criminal penalties, licence revocation, clawback, suspension or blocking provisions, so no sanction regime is coded here.
